shortBio.en: Chess guitarist and songwriter; duck-walk stage and double-stop riffs on early rock radio.
shortBio.zh: Chess 吉他手与写歌人；鸭步舞台与双音停顿 riff，进入早期摇滚电台。

body.en:
Born 1926, St. Louis. Chess Records sides from the mid-1950s. Double-stop guitar intros and verse storytelling set a template many UK invasion bands copy.

Continues touring and recording for decades. Dies 2017.
body.zh:
1926 年生于圣路易斯。1950 年代中期起 Chess 单曲。双音停顿吉他 intro 与主歌叙事，被许多英国入侵乐队沿用。

此后数十年仍巡演与录音。2017 年去世。
